context.content: soulsplit is enough even with gear that low. Use a defender+main hand, that way you can revenge to boost dps, reflect to halve damage and resonance for large heals. If you feel comfortable switching around, then you can just use shield+mainhand switch for when those abilities are off cooldown. Try to use AOE abilities to damage them all at the same time like fire breathing and chain. If you have a 2 handed meele weapon like a godsword then you could use berserk with hurricane/quake to kill all 3 at same time. But dont use bleeds on linza her reflect can trigger each hit I did it without food and felt it was way too easy, i used T90 and forgot potions (forgot to pack supplies). but should still be very doable with T70, just might need some food and potions
